{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Innovation and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high R&D investment and profitability tend to outperform due to their ability to innovate and maintain competitive advantage.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Financial Health and Earnings Quality", 
"mechanism": "Companies with strong financial health and high earnings quality tend to perform better due to their lower risk and more sustainable earnings.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "NetPayoutYield"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "AbnormalAccruals"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Growth and Valuation", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high growth prospects and reasonable valuations tend to outperform due to their potential for future earnings growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "EntMult"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Momentum and Reversal", 
"mechanism": " Stocks with high momentum tend to continue outperforming in the short term, while those with low momentum tend to reverse in the long term.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "LRreversal"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Quality and Leverage", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high quality and low leverage tend to outperform due to their lower risk and more stable earnings.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "MomOffSeason", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Intangibles and Investment", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets and investment tend to outperform due to their potential for future growth and innovation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Earnings and Financial Statement Analysis", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high earnings quality and strong financial statement analysis tend to outperform due to their more accurate earnings and lower risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "TotalAccruals"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6mJunk", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Liquidity and Trading Volume", 
"mechanism": "Stocks with high liquidity and trading volume tend to outperform due to their lower transaction costs and higher market efficiency.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "VolMkt"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}
]}
